response: According to a small retrospective study, updated Pap test screening guidelines would not have missed invasive cancer on average among screened women aged 30 and older. However, young patients aged 21-29 years may be at increased risk of developing invasive cervical cancer between the recommended screening intervals. This suggests that the updated guidelines may be effective for older women, but additional consideration may be needed for younger women to ensure they are not at a higher risk of developing invasive cervical cancer.
